propositions: Completion verifier receives zero file contents upfront and discovers files agentically, causing 84-158 requests per run dominated by read_file/search_files round-trips; 67-82% of measured distinct file reads overlap with declared file_impact union, indicating re-fetching of already-named files.

Close-gate verifier runs exhaust exploration budget via runaway loops searching for expected text; prefetching the ticket's own declared file_impact (close path, graph=False) plus referencing-commit diffs into a labelled context section reduces discovery overhead.

Prefetch must honour the close gate's graph=False boundary: own file_impact only on close path; subtree union ranked by cross-descendant frequency only on graph=True deep-review path; generic review-ticket callers remain byte-identical (prefetch=None default).

Prefetch section is ranked, skeleton-compressed if >500 lines, clamped per-file and by 30k-token aggregate budget, and includes a manifest tracking full|skeleton modes; recovery successors inherit the prefetch via shared ticket_context and physical_context_ceiling trims oversized prefetch rather than raising.
